gaps.sentence: I'm learning ___ the guitar at the moment.
gaps.explanation: learn takes the to-infinitive (learn how to play).

gaps.sentence: Would you mind ___ the window? It's boiling in here.
gaps.explanation: mind is followed by -ing: Would you mind opening…?

gaps.sentence: I'd like ___ a word with you, please.
gaps.explanation: would like always takes the to-infinitive: I'd like to have.
pretend + to-infinitive; negative: not to hear.

gaps.sentence: I can't imagine ___ in a tiny village again.
I really can't afford ___ on holiday this year.
gaps.explanation: afford takes the to-infinitive: can't afford to go.

gaps.sentence: They can't help ___ at his impression of the boss.
gaps.explanation: can't help + -ing = can't stop yourself: can't help laughing.

gaps.sentence: He went on ___ even after the audience had left.
gaps.explanation: go on + -ing = continue the same activity; go on to do = do something next.
